description: NSW strategic freight forecasts and freight movement model is a group of 2 related entries of the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue, listed under the National Freight Data Hub group and published by Transport for NSW. Members: NSW Freight Commodity Demand Forecasts 2016-2056; Strategic Freight Movement Model. Example entry: These visualisations feature NSW freight commodity demand forecasts by origin at Statistical Area Level 3 (SA3) and origin-destination at Statistical Area Level 4 (SA4). Prepared by Advanced Analytics and Insights, these forecasts reflect growth based on underlying market drivers of freight commodity demand between 2016 and 2056. Coverage is New South Wales, 2015 to 2056; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as infrequent, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-23. Files and pages listed: HTML (5 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
